raw.headline: Prioritize Usability next quarter, with a fast-track fix for Playback
raw.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation
Put next quarter's main product effort into Usability, led by `usability/ui_layout` and `usability/ads`. Usability has the most complaints and the largest total severity among the four named areas ({{C055}} complaints, severity total {{C056}}). Playback is a close second and should get a fast-track fix because it has the highest mean severity among the higher-volume areas ({{C061}}).

## Evidence
Usability is the largest of the four areas by volume and total severity: {{C055}} complaints with severity total {{C056}}, versus Playback at {{C059}} complaints and severity total {{C060}}. Its issues are spread across layout changes (`usability/ui_layout`, {{C021}} complaints), advertising (`usability/ads`, {{C026}} complaints) and queue controls (`usability/queue_playlist`, {{C031}} complaints). Playback is more concentrated: `playback/general` shows {{C016}} complaints at a mean severity of {{C018}}, covering loading failures and screens that stall. Billing/support has {{C063}} complaints with severity total {{C064}}. Its top issue, `billing/subscription_entitlement` ({{C006}} complaints), describes features moved behind premium, which overlaps with playback controls. Access has few complaints ({{C067}}) but the highest mean severity ({{C069}}), so it needs monitoring rather than a major investment. Some reviews use cancellation language. That is stated intent only, not observed churn, and {{C074}} records carry it.

## Alternatives considered
Playback ({{C059}} complaints, mean severity {{C061}}) is the strongest alternative. It ranks {{C020}} overall, but its severity sits mostly in one issue cluster. Billing/support ({{C063}} complaints) ranks {{C010}} as an issue, driven by premium gating. That is partly a pricing and entitlement decision, so billing/support ownership may be the better fit for it. Access is smallest by volume. Outside the four areas holds the largest share ({{C054}}), but it is mostly vague or catalog complaints (`other/general` at {{C001}} complaints, `catalog/general` at {{C036}}). Those are not yet actionable for a single product area.

## Limitations
Reviews are self-selected public app-store text, not a random sample. Cancellation language is stated intent, not observed churn, and this memo estimates no revenue, churn, or causal effect. Unresolved or quarantined records: {{C073}}, so no records are pending review. Completed records total {{C071}}, of which {{C072}} are complaint or cancellation records. Issue-level counts are small, so rankings could shift with a few additional reviews.

recommendations.rationale: Usability is the largest of the four areas by volume and total severity, and these two issues carry much of it, with reviews citing removed player features and ads replacing songs.
recommendations.title: Fix layout and ad disruption in the player and home screen

recommendations.rationale: Playback has the highest mean severity among the higher-volume areas, and reviews describe stalled loading screens and playback that does not start.
recommendations.title: Fast-track playback loading and failure fixes

recommendations.rationale: The top billing issue overlaps with playback controls, so the entitlement boundary should be decided jointly rather than assigned to product alone.
recommendations.title: Review premium gating of playback controls with billing/support

recommendations.rationale: The largest single issue is non-specific, so it should be clarified with tagging before it drives roadmap decisions.
recommendations.title: Triage vague complaints before committing effort
